specs.label: Material
specs.value: case is made of zinc alloy die-casting,

unmatched.label: Handing
unmatched.value: Fully reversible for left or right hand doors,564 can also be installed on outward opening doors.

unmatched.label: Door thickness
unmatched.value: 35mm-55mm is supplied as standard, lock suitable for 30mm-60mm door thickness is also available upon request.

unmatched.label: Structure
unmatched.value: 564 is of bevel latch structure,night latch of 1/2" (13mm) latch extension. Rim deadbolt, with the security of 1" (25mm) full throw deadbolt. With inside deadlocking button preventing any key operation and latch picking from outside.
